description: Feral Interactive’s port of Tomb Raider to iOS is a masterclass in how to revive a console classic for the modern mobile era. It brings the visceral, high-stakes original story of Lara Croft to a pocket powerhouse that does not compromise on graphics or depth in the slightest. On modern mobile silicon, the game strips off its decade-old skin to reveal a "Definitive" version, complete with silky smooth performance and intuitive controls that are perfect for both new and old fans alike.
title: Tomb Raider (iOS) Review: Feral Brings Lara Croft’s Bloody Adventure to Mobile in a Near Flawless Port

description: One of the most popular messaging apps around the world is WhatsApp. With the growing use of messaging apps among the youth of the world, parents always look for ways to allow their children to use these apps safely. To address these issues, WhatsApp has now come up with a new feature called Parent-Managed Accounts. So, if you are planning to allow your kid to use the app, here is how you can use the new feature called Parent-Managed Accounts.
title: How to Set Up a Parent-Managed Account on WhatsApp: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: The proposal — effectively a second phase of New Delhi’s flagship phone production program — will start rewarding companies for shipping devices overseas, the people said, asking not to be identified because the discussions are private. Unlike the current Production-Linked Incentive, or PLI, program which retires March 31 and is primarily focused on incremental domestic output, the new plan explicitly ties benefits to exports and localization.
title: India Prepares Smartphone Export Incentives in a Boost for Apple

description: Metaplanet plans to invest JPY 4 billion through a new venture initiative aimed at supporting startups building Bitcoin-related infrastructure. The Tokyo-listed company will deploy the funds over the next few years through its new subsidiaries and may also support incubator programmes and grants for developers working on the Bitcoin ecosystem.
title: Metaplanet Announces JPY 4 Billion Venture Arm to Support Japan's Startups, Bitcoin Infrastructure

description: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion+ has been quietly launched as a new addition to the Edge 70 lineup with upgraded camera hardware. The smartphone features a 50-megapixel Sony LYTIA 710 primary camera, a 50-megapixel ultrawide lens, and a 10-megapixel telephoto shooter. It is powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset and sports a 6.8-inch 144Hz AMOLED display. The phone packs a 5,200mAh battery with 68W fast charging, runs Android 16-based Hello UI, and is available in Brazil starting at BRL 2,969 (roughly Rs. 52,900).
title: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion+ Launched With Triple Rear Camera Setup, 5,200mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Nvidia released a new open-source artificial intelligence (AI) designed to handle complex agentic workflows. Dubbed Nemotron 3 Super, it is a hybrid mixture-of-experts (MoE) model that combines advanced reasoning capabilities and is said to complete tasks with high accuracy for autonomous agents. The new model is already being deployed by several AI firms, including Perplexity.
title: Nvidia Unveils Nemotron 3 Super Open-Source AI Model for Agentic AI Systems

description: Xiaomi 17 Ultra was recently launched in India and competes with the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra and iPhone 17 Pro Max in the premium flagship segment. All three phones feature large 6.9-inch OLED displays with 120Hz refresh rates and powerful chipsets. The Xiaomi model highlights camera hardware and fast charging, while Samsung focuses on Galaxy AI and a quad camera setup. Apple’s device emphasises the A19 Pro chip and ecosystem integration. The phones also differ in pricing, battery capacity, and camera configurations.
title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra vs Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra vs iPhone 17 Pro Max: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Hackers hijacked the Bonk.fun website and inserted a malicious prompt that tricked users into approving transactions that drained funds from connected wallets. The Solana-based platform warned users to avoid the domain until security is restored, while some users reported losses after interacting with the compromised site.
title: Bonk.fun Domain Hijacked in Wallet Drainer Attack Designed to Target Solana Users

description: Marvel’s Daredevil Born Again Season 2 follows Matt Murdock as he secretly fights Mayor Wilson Fisk’s corrupt rule while struggling between justice and revenge.
title: Daredevil Born Again Season 2 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Maamla Legal Hai Season 2 returns with Ravi Kishan as Judge V.D. Tyagi, bringing more bizarre and hilarious courtroom cases when it releases on April 3, 2026.
title: Maamla Legal Hai Season 2 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Ravi Kishan Starrer Courtroom Comedy Online?

description: Madam Sengupta is a Bengali thriller about a cartoonist investigating her daughter’s murder, now streaming in Hindi on Ultra Play OTT.
title: Madam Sengupta Hindi Dub Available for Streaming on This Platform: What You Need to Know

description: Ledger Donjon, a group of security researchers for the cryptocurrency wallet firm Ledger, claimed to have discovered a vulnerability that potentially affects millions of Android phones powered by MediaTek chipsets. Ledger’s Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Charles Guillemet claims that the security researchers used the CMF Phone 1 to discover the MediaTek vulnerability. The company executive claims that they were able to breach the phone’s foundational security within 45 seconds using a laptop. MediaTek Dimensity and Helio chipsets use Trustonic’s Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) to protect sensitive data on phones.
title: Researchers Discover MediaTek Chip Vulnerability That Could Impact Millions of Android Phones

description: The OTT platforms are ready to release fresh movies and web series this week, where top picks include Sankalp, Aspirants S3, Pookie, and more.
title: Top OTT Releases This Week (Mar 9 - Mar 15): The Taj Story, Aspirants Season 3, Made in Korea, and More

description: Apple has rolled out updates for iPhone models running on iOS 16 and iOS 15 operating systems. These updates are for those handsets that are not compatible with the latest versions of Apple's operating systems. Apple has confirmed that these updates resolve the vulnerabilities related to the Coruna exploit that was recently revealed. Apart from the iPhone, similar updates have been rolled out for older iPad models running on iPadOS 16 and iPadOS 15 operating systems.
title: Apple's iOS 16, iOS 15 Updates Roll Out With Coruna Exploit Fixes for Older iPhone Models

description: Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus series has been launched in select global markets, the US-based tech giant announced on Wednesday. The series includes the Intel Core Ultra 5 250K Plus and Core Ultra 7 270K Plus chips. The two Intel processors are set to go on sale in the US on March 26 via Intel’s authorised retail outlets. The company claims that the Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus series chips offer enhanced gaming and multi-thread performance compared to their predecessors. While the Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus features a 24-core CPU, the Core Ultra 5 250K Plus is equipped with an 18-core CPU.
title: Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus Series Launched With Up to 24-Core CPU: Price, Features

description: iPhone 18 Pro series is expected to launch later this year, and a new leak suggests the devices may retain a design similar to their predecessors. According to a tipster, Apple could reuse moulds from the previous generation, meaning the Dynamic Island and Face ID arrangement may remain unchanged. Under-display Face ID is said to be delayed. The phones are also tipped to feature a 2nm A20 Pro chip, a battery exceeding 5,000mAh, improved cameras, upgraded Siri AI, and a 24-megapixel front camera.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Tipped to Launch With A20 Pro Chip, No Changes to Dynamic Island

description: New Zealand’s Financial Markets Authority has determined that the NZDD stablecoin does not qualify as a financial product under current regulations. The decision follows testing through a fintech sandbox and clarifies that the token functions mainly as a payment tool rather than an investment instrument.
title: New Zealand Regulator Says NZDD Stablecoin Isn't a Financial Product, Will Act as Payment Tool

description: Perplexity unveiled the Personal Computer on Wednesday as an extension to the last month’s Perplexity Computer platform. Unlike what the name suggests, it is not a hardware system, but a dedicated tool for Apple’s Mac Mini that connects Perplexity Computer to a device, and allows it to access the local apps and files. With that, the multi-model agentic system can perform a wider range of complex tasks autonomously.
title: Perplexity Takes On Claude Cowork With Personal Computer, an Agentic AI Platform for Mac Mini

description: Poco X8 Pro 5G Iron Man Edition will be launched in India soon, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. The special edition is expected to ship with an Iron Man insignia on the rear panel, along with thematic red and gold accents. Separately, the price of the Poco X8 Pro 5G and Poco X8 Pro Max 5G in India has surfaced online. This comes soon after the tech firm revealed various details about the two upcoming smartphones. The Poco X8 Pro series is scheduled to be launched in India on March 17.
title: Poco X8 Pro Series Price in India Tipped as Company Teases Poco X8 Pro Iron Man Edition

description: Sony has announced the PS Plus Game Catalogue lineup for March. This month, Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, Persona 5 Royal, EA Sports Madden NFL 26, Blasphemous 2, Metal Eden, Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria, and Astroneer will join the game subscription service. All games will be playable starting March 17.
title: PS Plus Game Catalogue Lineup for March Revealed: Space Marine 2, Persona 5 Royal, Madden NFL 26 and More

description: Samsung is set to launch the Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G in India on March 17. A new leak suggests the phone could start at Rs. 13,999. The handset will feature a 6.7-inch 120Hz display, MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, and Android 16-based One UI 8 with six years of updates. It will offer a 50-megapixel main camera, a 6,000mAh battery with up to 26 hours of video playback, AI features like Google Gemini and Circle to Search, and an IP54-rated body.
title: Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G Price in India Leaked Ahead of March 17 Launch

description: Bitcoin traded near $69,000 on Thursday as macroeconomic uncertainty and rising geopolitical tensions kept investors cautious. Analysts said oil market volatility and inflation concerns are influencing risk appetite across global markets. Despite whale accumulation and steady ETF inflows, Bitcoin continues to trade within a narrow band while traders await fresh signals from US macro data and policy developments.
title: Bitcoin Price Settles Near $69,000, Continues to Face Strong Resistance Near $75,000 Mark

description: iQOO Z11x 5G has been launched in India as the latest addition to the Chinese smartphone maker’s Z-series. The handset is set to go on sale in India via Amazon. The phone will be available for purchase in the country in Prismatic Green and Titan Black colour options. It will be offered in 6GB +128GB, 8GB + 128GB, and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The handset is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset, along with up to 8GB of LPDDR4x RAM and up to 256GB of UFS 3.1 onboard storage. It features a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel primary shooter.
title: iQOO Z11x 5G Launched in India With 7,200mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Microsoft has revealed more details about its next-gen Xbox console, codenamed Project Helix. At the ongoing Game Developers Conference in San Francisco, the Xbox parent promised a major leap in performance and capability with the next Xbox. The company also announced that alpha versions of Project Helix will begin shipping to developers in 2027.
title: Microsoft Reveals Project Helix Details at GDC, Announces Xbox Mode for Windows 11

description: The OnePlus 15T has appeared publicly for the first time during a livestream ahead of its expected China launch later this month. The compact flagship will feature a 6.32-inch display, a 7,500mAh Glacier Battery, and is said to offer 100W wired charging with 50W wireless support. The phone will arrive in three colour options and include a metal cube-style camera module, upgraded LUMO periscope lens, ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, and IP66, IP68, IP69, and IP69K durability ratings.
title: OnePlus 15T Reportedly Appears in Livestream Ahead of Launch, Key Specifications Revealed

description: OpenAI is reportedly planning to bring the capabilities of its Sora artificial intelligence (AI) model to ChatGPT. As per the report, the San Francisco-based AI giant wants to add video generation to its main chatbot app’s arsenal. The move is interesting given that the company is yet to fully roll out the Sora app globally.
title: OpenAI Could Reportedly Integrate Sora AI Video Tool Into ChatGPT

description: Samsung is said to soon refresh its Galaxy A-series lineup with the rumoured introduction of the Galaxy A37 5G and Galaxy A57 5G. The latter, notably, was recently leaked via a retailer listing, which hinted towards its design, expected specifications, colour options, and availability. It is the Samsung Galaxy A37 5G, which has now surfaced in a similar listing, showcasing its renders, along with other details.
title: Samsung Galaxy A37 5G Design, Colour Options Leaked via Retailer Listing; Launch Timeline Surfaces

description: Vivo has revealed new details about the upcoming Vivo X300s ahead of its China launch. The smartphone is confirmed to feature a 7,100mAh “Blue Ocean Battery” using fourth-generation silicon-anode technology, along with an upgraded Ice Pulse Fluid VC cooling system. It will include Ultrasonic Fingerprint 2.0, USB 3.2 support, and Global Direct Drive Power Supply 2.0. Vivo also detailed gaming-focused upgrades such as the Monster Super Core Engine and signal amplification system.
title: Vivo X300s Confirmed to Feature 7,100mAh Battery, Ultrasonic Fingerprint Scanner and Gaming Optimisations

description: Apple will launch a new MacBook Air model, equipped with an OLED display, in either 2028 or 2029, according to TF Securities’ analyst Ming-Chi Kuo. He also reiterated his earlier forecast that the Cupertino-based tech giant will upgrade its MacBook Pro lineup with an OLED screen in the fourth quarter of 2026 (Q4FY26) or by the first quarter of 2027 (Q1FY27). However, Apple has yet to confirm these details. The launch timelines are in line with previous reports, which suggested that the MacBook Air with OLED screen could arrive in 2028, while the Pro lineup could get updated with the same later this year.
title: Apple's MacBook Air Unlikely to Get OLED Upgrade Soon; OLED MacBook Pro Could Arrive This Year: Kuo

description: Apple might be late to the party, but it is rumoured to finally introduce a foldable smartphone in 2026, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to confirm the handset, more details about the foldable model, ubiquitously known as the iPhone Fold, have emerged. As per a seasoned journalist, it could combine elements of both the iPhone and the iPad in its user interface. The layout may take advantage of its larger foldable display, allowing users to run two apps side by side.
title: iPhone Fold to Reportedly Feature iPad-Style User Interface, Support Split-Screen Apps

description: Meta Platforms announced a new set of anti-scam tools across its major messaging platforms on Wednesday. Rolling out on Facebook, Messenger, and WhatsApp, the additions are aimed at helping users identify and avoid online scams. As per the Menlo Park-based tech giant, new features include new in-app alerts, improved safety controls, and partnerships with financial institutions and technology firms.
title: WhatsApp Introduces Device Linkage Warning as Meta Expands Anti-Fraud Tools Across Facebook, Messenger
